summary: Michael James, 40, of Boulder, stand-up paddleboarding at the Staircase wave in the Buena Vista whitewater park, was swept downstream in high water (~4,000 cfs); fellow boaters could not reach him, and his body was recovered downstream near the Browns Canyon put-in and pronounced dead at 5:50 p.m.
location: Buena Vista whitewater park, Arkansas River (Staircase rapid)
notes: High water; Arkansas Headwaters Recreation Area also involved.
